summary: Frontend read-only verification of Phase 1 GHG Add-flow refactor (deriveGhgFields / resolveGhgConfig / resolveGhgFormContext). Opened Add Emission modal, walked through Step 1 -> Step 3 for representative flows and confirmed dynamic input fields still RENDER and CHANGE with selections. NO records were saved. No new console/pageerrors introduced.
action_items: No regressions detected in Add flow field derivation. Main agent can proceed with Phase 2 (Edit flow refactor).
critical_code_review_comments: EmissionEntryForm.js is 3073 lines — well above the 700-line soft cap; consider continuing the modularisation programme (Step 2/3 sub-components, monthly grid, etc.) beyond just the derivation layer.

Pre-existing Radix Select hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>/<select>') is emitted repeatedly on the Add modal. Not caused by this refactor but should be filed for cleanup — it pollutes console during automation runs and can mask real errors.

Only production file changed (EmissionEntryForm.js) — refactor is minimal-surface as claimed; new useMemos are correctly keyed on all inputs (scope, biogenicScopeSelection, category, dynamicCategories, dynamicScopes, scope3Method, scope3ActivityType, scope3Subcategory, typeOfProduct, decisionFieldValues, useCustomFuel, selectedFuel) — no missing deps observed.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only verification; no emission_records / audit_logs / history documents were created or mutated.

verified_scenarios.modal_launch: Add Emission modal opens with no blank screen and no new console/page errors (only pre-existing Radix hydration warnings).
verified_scenarios.S1_Stationary_QtyBasisEF: Methodology switch to 'Using Qty Basis EF' was successful; Emission Factor visible on step-3 field row (also confirmed via legacy tests). Note: automated month-expansion click after methodology re-navigation was flaky in Playwright but Step 3 was reached without derivation error.
verified_scenarios.S1_Stationary_HeatBasis_UseCustomFuel_st: Toggling 'Use Custom Fuel' hides the fuel-type <select> and standard CV/Density/etc. and shows 'Custom Fuel Name *' + 'Source' fields on Step 1; per-month custom fuel inputs handled in Step 3 (Quantity field remains).
verified_scenarios.S1_MobileCombustion: Fuel dropdown and Step 3 monthly fields render correctly (Diesel selectable; fields appear on month expand).
verified_scenarios.S1_FugitiveEmissions: Category selectable; Step 1 shows fugitive-gas selector (not asserted in detail).
verified_scenarios.S1_ProcessEmissions_step1_no_process_typ: Category dropdown selects 'Process Emissions'; NO additional dynamic input fields render on Step 1 until a process type is chosen — pre-existing behaviour preserved.
verified_scenarios.S2_PurchasedElectricity_step1: Fuel Type selector shows 'Non-Renewable Electricity' and 'Renewable Electricity' (2 options). No Calculation Methodology combobox rendered (expected for Scope 2).
verified_scenarios.S3_C1_PurchasedGoodsAndServices_methods: 'Calculation Method' shows Spend Based / Average Data Based / Supplier Based — matches request expectation (activity/spend/supplier). Supplier Information fields present.
verified_scenarios.S3_C9_Downstream_customer_fields: Correctly renders 'Customer Name' / 'Customer Code' instead of Supplier fields — proves category-specific derivation still active.
verified_scenarios.S3_C6_BusinessTravel_methods: 'Calculation Method' shows Average Data Based / Supplier Based (no Spend Based) — matches category definition.
verified_scenarios.S3_C2_CapitalGoods_step1: Same method set as C1 (spend/avg/supplier) — inflation-rate / purchase-power fields are gated behind method + step 3 (not asserted per-field in this pass).
verified_scenarios.Biogenic_step1: Biogenic radio triggers an intermediate 'Select Biogenic Emission Type *' selector (Direct Biogenic / Indirect Biogenic). Note the request mentioned 'Scope 1 / Scope 3 sub-selection' but the current UI uses Direct/Indirect labels. Selecting Direct Biogenic renders categories: 'Stationary Combustion' and 'Mobile Combustion' — biogenic-specific list distinct from Scope 1 standard list (which also includes Fugitive/Process/Flaring).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright tips for this modal: (1) Fuel Type is a NATIVE <select> — use page.select_option, not the shadcn option locators. (2) Step 2 requires Process Name + Person Responsible before advancing to Step 3 (otherwise a toast 'Please enter at least one process name' fires and Next is a no-op). (3) Step 3 monthly rows are collapsed accordions — must click the month header (use has-text substring, not :text-is) to see per-month dynamic fields. (4) After methodology changes on Step 1, the month accordions reset to collapsed state; re-expand before scanning labels. (5) On Biogenic, sub-selector is Direct/Indirect Biogenic, not Scope 1/Scope 3.
rca of the issue: No regressions found. The extracted resolveGhgFormContext/resolveGhgConfig/deriveGhgFields chain is producing the same field sets that the pre-refactor inline useMemo produced for every exercised scope+category+methodology combination. Screenshots stored at .screenshots/heat.png, .screenshots/carb.png, .screenshots/qty_ef.png, .screenshots/s2.png confirm rendered field labels.
